title: Section 110.26(A)(1) – Add a new Informational Note at the end of Section 110.26(A)(1) to read as follows:
officialText:
Informational Note: For Service Rooms or areas with equipment totaling 1000 kVA or larger, see 230.64 for minimum
clearance requirements.
Section 110.26(G) – Add a new Section 110.26(G) to read as follows:
(G) Network Compartments. All network compartments shall have at least 2 means of access. Each door shall access
an area that leads to a legal exit.
